policy: Only two original Polish CL2 chapel records — Bajerze and Bukowiec — have consistent first-party individual-page and district-register identity and source timetable patterns in this release.
Other Phase27M certificates have independently observed source conflicts and remain excluded pending identity/time adjudication.
Source-published patterns only, not guaranteed dated Mass events or synthetic RRULEs.
Conditional first Friday, first Saturday and Thursday preceding first Friday must not be recast as ordinary weekly Friday/Thursday Masses.
No inferred missal edition, Una Cum, canonical status, individual priest, legal ownership, confirmed entrance, current open hours or future occurrence.
Older or printed first-party sources can be overridden by local announcements; verify before travel.
